end.summary: Practised reading and plotting ordered pairs (x, y) on a coordinate grid.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised identifying the horizontal x-movement first and the vertical y-movement second, including placing (2, –3) in Quadrant IV. They correctly stated that positive x and negative y give Quadrant IV, and used (4, 3) as right 4, up 3. The mix-up that (3, 2) and (2, 3) are the same point remained after the final check; it was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Harsh to plot both points on squared paper and label each movement separately.
